raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Francesca Schiavone Wikipedia page and incorrectly stated that Schiavone was runner-up at the 2011 Wimbledon, when she was actually runner-up at the 2011 French Open. This misinterpretation led to an incorrect focus on Wimbledon as the shared tournament instead of the correct overlap (the French Open).
